score.meaning: A stronger local study: the phone attention now relates to the visible question, and the new pose adaptation respects paused inspection, replay, theme changes and reduced motion. The modest 0.2 increase recognizes that concrete spatial/behavioral improvement and new bounded keyboard evidence. It does not imply proven comfort or comprehension, and the unchanged discoverability and validation gaps prevent a nine-level claim.

strengths: The before/current 320px and 390px scene captures visibly change the reading direction from lateral/downward emphasis to an upward glance beneath the question. The actual phone scene keeps readable question text, a recognizable tiny character and its playback controls; no anatomy enlargement or layout compression was used.

The complete supplied 390px phases in both themes show attention toward the question during noticing/reading and a return toward the visitor before the outward mitten arrives. The mapper is exactly inactive by 2350ms, so the offer is not visually pulled back toward the heading.

Interaction semantics survive the new adaptive pose. The controller freezes a paused inspection frame across resize, uses cached geometry only after an explicit seek or bounded active-time retarget, and carries the displayed correction through replay. These are concrete comfort improvements to an adaptive rendering path; they avoid autonomous eye/head motion while a visitor is trying to inspect a still.

The adaptation changes only five attention channels and shares one numeric pose across paint themes. Plain curious is excluded. Recorded cases around the 650/651px layout boundary retain exact control/return invariants and no horizontal overflow.

The updated hand sheets give the offering mitten a more open contour at 160/240px and lower the free/supporting hands out of the busiest ruff region. Thinking keeps intentional chin contact and grateful keeps an intentional small clasp; the character remains compact and innocent.

The new recorded keyboard checks demonstrate Play focus, Pause/Resume behavior and a one-step range change into Pose inspection. Still-first selection, state-based status updates, native controls, per-variant descriptions, reduced-motion Show copy, no automatic resume and capability-based UI feedback remain intact.

improvementCriteria: Keep the corrected phone gaze and display-pose continuity while observing a real phone compare/play/pause/seek task without coaching.
Verify native menu keyboard commit and screen-reader speech separately from programmatic selection or key activation of ordinary buttons.
Evaluate a first and delayed return task, including finding a quiet feeling and the larger single-theme view. Record assistance and scroll exposure.
Inspect 200% text/zoom, real phone landscape and a resize while paused/resumed; retain natural scrolling, zoom and static inspection.

Assess continuous playback on intended devices and neutral human interpretation before claiming smoothness, comfortable repetition or invitation comprehension. Keep tiny anatomy and meaningful chin/clasp contact.
implementedAssessment: Acceptable as the updated local foundation. No high-impact concrete interaction defect was found in the inspected implementation. The new staging strengthens spatial coherence without new control burden, autoplay or autonomous paused movement. The retained limits are nonblocking for local study acceptance and remain material to stronger claims.

workflowChanges: Add a displayed-pose continuity check whenever layout-aware character adaptation is introduced; testing the raw engine pose alone misses a possible replay snap.
Treat paused resize, paint-only theme changes and explicit seek as three separate cases. A frozen inspection pose should remain still until an intentional action; a theme should never change pose.
Check both sides of a responsive breakpoint and the actual neutral eye-to-heading geometry, while keeping DOM reads out of the animation frame mapper.
Keep the unchanged first-viewport discovery and Both-default questions in the same review scope after a visual refinement; do not treat improvement in one area as evidence for another.
Use a concrete evidence ladder: source and unit test, recorded programmatic case, actual keyboard action, spoken AT, hardware behavior, observed newcomer/revisit outcome.

rulesNotApplicableWithReason.rule: Sub-300ms interface limit or never animate keyboard actions applied to the 380ms pose handoff
rulesNotApplicableWithReason.reason: The handoff is continuity within deliberately requested character content, not a delayed button or focus response. Keyboard Play must still play the requested performance.

rulesNotApplicableWithReason.rule: GPU-only transforms/opacity used to rewrite tiny SVG anatomy
rulesNotApplicableWithReason.reason: The user requires unchanged paths and proportions. Expressive eye/head/hand channels have a content purpose. Avoid per-frame layout reads and profile actual cost before considering rendering changes.

rulesNotApplicableWithReason.reason: A paused or reduced-motion inspection frame is intentionally stable. Cache new layout and apply it on an explicit action or active-time retarget; no independent gaze animation is appropriate.
